title_zh: 更正虚构国家制度图并分开政策立场

scenario.label_zh: 区分总统制结构与进步政策立场
scenario.goal_zh: 根据课堂案例补画议会，并把政策立场说明从政府结构图移到单独栏

context_zh: 学生核对关于虚构国家的公民课图示。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: My chart shows the president making every law. The case says this is a presidential system.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: But it also says parliament debates and passes laws. You've left that branch out.

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: I thought the description of the president as progressive meant the office had extra powers.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: That describes her support for social reform, not the structure of the government.

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: Then I'll add parliament and put her policy views in a separate box.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Let's check the arrows against the case notes before we hand it in.
